ContextBefore.Source: Embedded synthetic fixture; no product data directory, scanning or user icon cache.

ContextAfter.Source: Embedded synthetic fixture; no product data directory, scanning or user icon cache.

IdleEvidence: Fixed embedded 28-item fixture; all home rows pre-rendered; no scan or background business tasks; finite entry/hover animations settled; no screenshots during sampling.
UnavailableMetrics: GPU fields are null if the Windows GPU Process Memory provider has no readable instance; null is not zero. Renderer-internal texture/glyph cache bytes are unavailable.
Embedded icons use Slint caches; no application-owned decoded icon LRU exists yet.
Limitations: PrivateBytes is private commit, not physical resident memory. WorkingSet sums double-count shared pages.
CPUPercentOfMachine is normalized by logical processors. Process/window polling can miss changes entirely between polls.
IdleConfirmed is operator confirmation after scanning; log evidence alone cannot prove the live scanning flag.
No startup or key-to-editable latency is measured. Diagnostics mode must be compared separately.
